headline: Altán will expand the Red Compartida with private capital, 10-year contracts and technology from Nokia and Huawei
summary: Altán will expand the Red Compartida network with private capital and 10-year contracts. Investors must fund even the electronic equipment from Nokia and Huawei, with inflation-adjusted rents.
why: Red Compartida is Mexico's shared wholesale wireless network, and its financing model determines how telecom infrastructure is built and paid for.

impacts.name: Nokia
impacts.why: Nokia equipment is part of the infrastructure that the expansion must fund.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Altán ampliará la Red Compartida con capital privado, contratos a 10 años y tecnología de Nokia y Huawei
